name: read_fountain
command:
import os,resource; os.sched_setaffinity(0,sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0))[:2]); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU,(115,115)); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS,(6*1024**3,6*1024**3));
import subprocess
from pathlib import Path
p=Path.cwd();t=subprocess.run(['pdftotext','-layout',str(p/'sources/fountain.pdf'),'-'],capture_output=True,text=True,check=True).stdout
subprocess.run(['python3','-I','-B',str(p/'write_lane.py'),'sources/fountain.txt'],input=t,text=True,check=True,capture_output=True);print(t)
